SEVERAL CLASS F RESTRICTED AREAS (CYRS) HAVE BEEN ESTABLISHED IN
THE ALMA REGION FOR THE FLIGHT TESTING OF REMOTELY PILOTED
AIRCRAFT (RPA). THESE CYRS ARE ACTIVATED OCCASIONALLY BY NOTAM,
ISSUED 48 HOURS TO 7 DAYS IN ADVANCE. NO PERSON SHALL OPERATE AN
AIRCRAFT WITHIN AN ACTIVE CYR UNLESS AUTHORIZED BY THE USER
AGENCY AS STATED IN THE DESIGNATED AIRSPACE HANDBOOK (DAH). ONCE
AUTHORIZATION HAS BEEN OBTAINED, PILOTS MUST CONTACT THE UAS CE
RANGE SAFETY OFFICER ON ALMA MF UNICOM (122.35) TO RECEIVE
FINAL CLEARANCE TO OPERATE WITHIN THE ACTIVE CYR. UNLESS THE
FLIGHT IS DEEMED ESSENTIAL (MEDEVAC, LAW ENFORCEMENT, EMERGENCY,
ETC.) ACCESS MAY BE DELAYED. WHEN CYR651 IS ACTIVE AND USE OF
THE ALMA AIRPORT IS REQUIRED, PILOTS MUST COMPLETE THIS TWO-STEP
PROCEDURE PRIOR TO ANY GROUND ACCESS TO THE RUNWAY, AND PRIOR TO
ANY ENTRY INTO THE CYR IN FLIGHT. ONCE AUTHORIZED, PILOTS MUST
ENTER AND EXIT CYR651 FROM THE NORTHEAST, OPERATIONS ARE THEN
LIMITED TO CIRCUIT PROCEDURES FOR ARRIVALS AND DEPARTURES AT THE
AIRPORT ONLY. SEE ALMA VTPC FOR DEPICTION OF THE CYRS.

AERONEF DANS UNE CYR ACTIVE SANS AUTORISATION PREALABLE DE
L'ORGANISME UTILISATEUR (VOIR DAH). UNE FOIS L'AUTORISATION
OBTENUE, LES PILOTES DOIVENT COMMUNIQUER SUR LA MF UNICOM D'ALMA

L'AUTORISATION FINALE D'EVOLUER DANS LA CYR ACTIVE. A MOINS
QU'IL NE S'AGISSE D'UN VOL ESSENTIEL (MEDEVAC, POLICE, URGENCE,

ET EN SORTIR PAR LE NORD-EST, PUIS LES OPERATIONS SONT LIMITEES
AUX PROCEDURES DE CIRCUIT POUR LES ARRIVEES ET LES DEPARTS A

REPRESENTATION DES CYR.)
